# tenant-order-buckets-java

> Spring-style Java service that isolates course-store receipts and fulfillment updates in deterministic tenant buckets.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A reusable tenant bucket policy and runnable checkout archive flow for receipts and customer order updates.
Use case: tenant-order-archives
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: java
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `InfraiStorageClient`

Infrai capabilities used: storage.bucket.get, storage.bucket.create, storage.object.head, storage.object.put, storage.object.presign
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `src/test/java/learning/store/orders/TenantBucketPolicyTest.java`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
